name: Path Tracing Engine (Radiance iOS Chapter 2.2)
description: Offscreen path-traced frame from the real Minecraft world: ingests chunk meshes + vertex-color albedo into Metal acceleration structures (2.1 sealed contract: section-local vertices, instance = translate(origin)), then renders a full path-traced image (sun direct + shadow rays + diffuse bounces) and saves it as PNG. Chapter 2 stage 2.2 acceptance probe for the Radiance iOS port.
